method.description: Verification-only disposition of three Michigan queue rows that name sub-parts of SCAO forms rather than documents. Both parent forms were fetched by direct HTTPS GET from the official SCAO forms path, hashed with SHA-256, compared against the digests the repository already records, and inspected for the specific structural features the three rows describe.
method.binaryDeposition: Neither retrieved parent binary is committed by this job, and neither needed to be deposited: the repository already holds both at the same bytes.

acquisitions.structuralEvidence: Item 2.c is present verbatim in the retrieved MC 227 bytes: 'I am requesting a first violation operating while intoxicated offense to be set aside. At least five years have passed since sentence was imposed or discharge from imprisonment, probation, or parole for the conviction, whichever is later. I have not been convicted of any offense during that time. I have not previously applied to have and had a first violation operating while intoxicated offense conviction set aside.' It sits in the item-2 eligibility series spanning pages 1 to 2 and is a checkbox line, not a document.
acquisitions.recommendedDisposition: Merge into MI:MC-227 as a field-level selector for mi_setaside_first_owi. Do not carry it as an acquirable document.

acquisitions.structuralEvidence: Page 3 of the retrieved MC 227 bytes is headed 'Application to Set Aside Conviction(s) (3/25)' and 'Page 3 of 3', and carries NOTICE OF HEARING followed by PROOF OF SERVICE. The proof of service is a section of page 3, not a separate filing.

Page 3 of the retrieved MC 227b bytes is headed 'Application for Human Trafficking Victim to Set Aside Conviction(s) (7/24)' and 'Page 3 of 3', and likewise carries NOTICE OF HEARING followed by PROOF OF SERVICE.
acquisitions.trackBindingWarning: This row belongs to MC 227b, not MC 227. The distinction is load-bearing: MC 227b is the required form where the conviction was a direct result of human trafficking, and the retrieved bytes confirm MC 227b contains no item 2.c at all — its item 2 is a single narrative field. Merging this row into MC 227 would bind the trafficking track to the wrong form.

redundantAcquisitionWorkRemoved.rationale: No issuer interaction can produce any of these three as a document, because the issuer does not publish them as documents. They are a checkbox line and two page-3 sections of forms the repository already holds at the publisher's exact bytes.

correctionsRaised.recommendation: Set the revision to REV-2025-03. The canonical relative path embeds REV-UNKNOWN and inherits the defect, so it needs regenerating with the corrected revision.
correctionsRaised.notAppliedRationale: The adopted edition is a forbidden path for this job.
correctionsRaised.note: The repository already holds the bytes that prove the revision. REV-UNKNOWN here is a metadata gap, not an evidentiary one — unlike Idaho's BCI application, where REV-UNKNOWN is the correct value because the form carries no revision marking at all.

unresolved.question: Both PDFs were regenerated in January 2026 while retaining their 3/25 and 7/24 revision stamps. Does the repository need to distinguish file date from revision?
